name: {{appName}}: Desktop Companion
subtitle: A little quiet company
description:
Meet Mallow, a soft lavender companion for your Mac. It rests beneath the notch with its face visible, blinking and breathing while you work.

INTERACT DIRECTLY
{{interactionHelp}} A second touch gets a wave or a gentle swing. Release near its home to catch it, or farther away for gravity and a squishy landing.

QUIET BY DEFAULT
Mallow returns to its small peek after you move on. Transparent margins pass clicks through. Displays without a notch use an upper-right resting place. Reduce Motion limits decorative movement; Low Power Mode, display sleep and session changes are respected.

MAKE IT YOURS
Right-click Mallow to open Settings. Choose character size, movement intensity and home display/location. Changes apply immediately and are saved on this Mac.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
No account, advertising, analytics or server connection. No screen capture or global keyboard monitoring. Plugins and assistant services are not active in this preview.

Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or later.
promotionalText: Meet Mallow: a soft, living companion beneath your notch. Hover, touch, drag and let it settle. Native, quiet and local.
reviewNotes:
This is the Mallow rewrite preview. It has no account, backend, payments, active plugins, login registration or special permissions. It appears directly in a transparent, nonactivating floating panel. It has no Dock icon, permanent menu-bar item or action cards.

{{interactionHelp}} Touch again to react; drag to play. Release near its home to catch; click elsewhere to return. A display without a notch uses an upper-right home below the menu bar.

Right-click Mallow to return it home and choose {{settingsMenu}} or {{quitApp}} from its small menu. Settings is an ordinary native window that activates only when explicitly requested. Character size, movement intensity and home display/location apply immediately and persist in local preferences. A missing selected display falls back without erasing the saved choice. Reduce Motion takes priority. Reopening from Finder returns it home without requesting keyboard focus. The app observes outside mouse clicks only to dismiss the character and reads no clicked content. It does not monitor global keyboard input. Reduce Motion limits decorative movement and animation suspends during system or display sleep, screen lock or an inactive session.

This metadata is for local preparation; this rewrite has not been submitted to Apple.
